chunks: The day when it reveals its radiance,

key_terms.جَلَّاهَا: He revealed it / He made it shine

ai.seo_question: What happens to the sun on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Ash-Shams?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ash-Shams is often linked to the cosmic upheavals preceding the final reckoning, where the sun's 'light' (daha) is unveiled to expose the truth of human deeds. It serves as a powerful reminder of divine justice, emphasizing that no action remains hidden from Allah on that day. The imagery underscores the transition from the relative clarity of this world to the absolute transparency of the Hereafter.
